cluster_recommendation:
explainer, codebase-video and repo-education are not three views of one product; they are three independently invented answers to the same brief, proven on the literal same pilot target (campaignbuilder) within days of each other, with zero mutual awareness. But they are not equally shaped: explainer's promised worked example doesn't exist on disk, repo-education is invisible to Claude Code's own routing entirely, and codebase-video is the only one with a tested, deterministic, receipt-producing delivery mechanism (video_project.py + unit tests). The comprehension/grounding/evidence disciplines, however, are genuinely different and each has real ideas worth keeping: explainer's claims-ledger + graded-KB-with-heldout-questions gate (A-E) is the strongest correctness mechanism in the batch; repo-education's evidence-packet schema (source/runtime/visual basis, cited IDs, needs_evidence/blocked states) and its stop-and-ask-before-fixing-product-code discipline are the strongest safety mechanism; codebase-video's manifest schema + hash-verified receipts is the strongest delivery mechanism.

Recommended target shape: one `explainer` family, `agentbox/skills/explainer/` as the hub, with a shared core (comprehension arc + claims-ledger format + scope boundary + stop-and-ask rule, merged from all three) and three delivery references selected by requested output — `references/delivery-docs.md` (the current docs+kb bundle, gates A/C/E), `references/delivery-video.md` (codebase-video's manifest/compositor, reused verbatim rather than re-specified), `references/delivery-microsite.md` (repo-education's inspectable reading-surface + evidence-packet model, with the HP Qwen direct-vision step demoted from "the workflow" to an optional, clearly-labelled supervised-drafting aid given it needs a manual per-session container and loses Loom's grounding for no vision benefit). codebase-video stays a standalone skill too (it has legitimate standalone callers — "technical onboarding films" without a docs bundle) but should be explicitly documented as both a specialist codebase-video pulls the docs' claims ledger will hand off to, cross-linked from the new explainer hub. If a full merge is too large a single change, the minimum viable fix is: (1) delete or fix explainer's dead campaignbuilder pointer, (2) register repo-education in SKILL-DIRECTORY.md and routing-table.md, (3) add a "when to choose which" table cross-linked from all three SKILL.md files stating the audience/output/grounding-method differences verbatim, so the next author doesn't reinvent a fourth shape.
